title: Athena Small Metallic Leather Convertible Clutch
description_html:
Athena Small Metallic Leather Convertible Clutch by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 10”W X 6”H X 3”D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Metallic leather
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
